sessions_device_name_length_check.name: sessions_device_name_length_check
sessions_device_name_length_check.value: "sessions"."device_name" is null or char_length("sessions"."device_name") between 1 and 60

auth_tokens_mobile_exchange_check.name: auth_tokens_mobile_exchange_check
auth_tokens_mobile_exchange_check.value: ("auth_tokens"."purpose" = 'mobile_exchange' and "auth_tokens"."code_challenge" is not null and "auth_tokens"."client" in ('ios','android')) or ("auth_tokens"."purpose" <> 'mobile_exchange' and "auth_tokens"."code_challenge" is null and "auth_tokens"."client" is null)

user_identities_credentials_check.name: user_identities_credentials_check
user_identities_credentials_check.value: ("user_identities"."provider" = 'password' and "user_identities"."password_hash" is not null and "user_identities"."provider_subject" is null) or ("user_identities"."provider" = 'google' and "user_identities"."provider_subject" is not null and "user_identities"."password_hash" is null)

payment_bank_check.name: payment_bank_check
payment_bank_check.value: ("member_payment_methods"."kind" = 'bank' and "member_payment_methods"."bank_bin" is not null and "member_payment_methods"."bank_bin" ~ '^[0-9]{6}$' and "member_payment_methods"."account_name" is not null and char_length("member_payment_methods"."account_name") between 1 and 50 and "member_payment_methods"."account_number" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9]{4,19}$') or ("member_payment_methods"."kind" <> 'bank' and "member_payment_methods"."bank_bin" is null and "member_payment_methods"."account_number" ~ '^0[0-9]{9}$')

chat_link_codes_target_check.name: chat_link_codes_target_check
chat_link_codes_target_check.value: purpose = 'group' and group_id is not null and platform_user_id is null
